fixture.data_scope: Synthetic QA state only; no API, account, production data or LiveKit session.

web_manual_safari_voice_dock_smoke_2026_.procedure: Native Safari keyboard smoke using Option+Tab, Return and Space against the production Vue voice-dock and profile-footer components mounted in the isolated fixture.
observations: Focus moved through microphone, deafen, screen share, leave, profile and audio settings without an observed focus trap.
The settings gear displayed a visible focus outline; activating it updated the live status to “Настройки аудио открыты”.
Space toggled microphone state; its accessible name and pressed state changed.
Return toggled deafen state; its accessible name and pressed state changed.
Activating screen share moved the fixture action into its disabled STARTING state; the fixture does not open the native capture picker.
Activating leave changed the status to “Завершаем голосовое подключение” and disabled the leave action.

screenshot.related_captures: Review-only desktop/mobile target-geometry captures and hashes are recorded in QA-301.

limitations: This validates Web production components in an isolated fixture, not the authenticated full application or a real LiveKit session.
VoiceOver/NVDA/TalkBack/Narrator, physical-device traversal, iOS Safari and native capture-picker acceptance were not run.
Safari used its default Full Keyboard Access policy; this is not screen-reader acceptance.
